title: Unit-preserving affine composition mates and restriction coherence
statement: Let U,t,L,a,e,he,c,hc be the continuous affine functors, comparisons, left adjoints, adjunctions and unit formulas of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-restriction-unit] and [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]. Let gamma satisfy the inclusion equation of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-restriction-composition-gamma]. There exists d_f,g: L_f L_g isomorphic to L_(gf) satisfying the affine iterated-unit formula, and restriction of c_f,g followed by e_(gf) equals e_g followed by L_g(e_f) followed by d_f,g. These are exactly the two displayed identities in Lean; d is constructed, not arbitrary.

proof.text: Precomposition on sheaves applied to gamma yields the isomorphism between the composite affine direct image and the affine direct image for gf. Compose a_f and a_g. Taking the unit-compatible mate of the right-adjoint isomorphism gives d: L_f L_g isomorphic to L_(gf). Evaluate its mate equation at V and s. The composite unit is eta_f followed by U_f^s(eta_g), and the map on sections induced by gamma is restriction along gamma_V. These are exactly the two sides of the affine composition-unit formula.

Let E_G be the iterated restriction comparison e_g on the full f-inverse image followed by L_g applied to e_f. Precompose both routes in the final square by E_G inverse, obtaining two morphisms from L_g L_f rho_X G to L_(gf) rho_X G, one of which is d. Transpose both by the composed affine adjunction. At an affine V and s in G(V), the transpose starts with eta_f(s) followed by eta_g. The unit equations for e_f and e_g identify this with the iterated full-site unit after applying E_G inverse. The assumed equation for c identifies its image with restriction of the composite full-site unit along pullbackComp inverse. The equation defining gamma rewrites those restrictions as restriction along gamma_V; the unit equation for e_(gf) then identifies the result with the affine composite unit. This is the transpose of d by the previous step. The transposes agree at every V and s, hence agree as sheaf morphisms. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence and cancellation of E_G give the final square. Choose gamma and d for every pair f,g.
